overview: The time update packet is a server-authoritative clock correction: two longs broadcast once per second, with the doDaylightCycle gamerule folded into the sign of worldTime. Server-side anticheats never reference it. The corpus sweep for the packet names S03PacketTimeUpdate and PacketPlayOutTimeUpdate returns zero hits, and the keyword pass over 'Time' only surfaces timer utilities, TimeUtil classes and tick-delta heuristics, none of which read this packet. The client never reports its displayed time back, so the cancel-and-pin time modules are invisible on the wire and no check in any cloned anticheat targets them.
